title.en: the vörösmarty christmas market is open.
title.de: der weihnachtsmarkt am vörösmarty tér ist offen.

line.en: the christmas market on vörösmarty tér runs daily until 31 december, 11:00 to 21:00 on weekdays. a short walk after work, with hungarian crafts and festive food.
line.de: der weihnachtsmarkt auf dem vörösmarty tér läuft täglich bis 31. dezember, werktags von 11:00 bis 21:00. ein kurzer weg nach der arbeit, mit ungarischem kunsthandwerk und festlichen speisen.
line.tr: vörösmarty tér'deki noel pazarı 31 aralık'a kadar her gün açık, hafta içi 11:00 ile 21:00 arası. iş çıkışı kısa bir yürüyüş; macar el sanatları ve festival yemekleri var.

sparks.why: Vörösmarty Classic Xmas market, open from 13 Nov to 31 Dec, weekdays 11:00 to 21:00 (Dinepass listing, budapest.hu); the season was confirmed by Pénzcentrum, the official market site was not checked.
